name: malformed-error-envelope
description: A v3 HTTP error response whose JSON body is not a well-formed ApiResponseEnvelope. The transport must never crash on it; it normalizes the malformed fields into a TDAMError.
why_malformed: `code` is a string ("E_BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE"), not the number required by ApiResponseEnvelope.code, so the business code cannot be trusted.
`message` is null, so no server-supplied message can be surfaced.
`data` is a primitive string, not an object, so no error details can be preserved.
